G3_faithfulness.justification: Because each of the three coordinate count sets sums to \(k\), a sum of squares equal to \(3k\) holds exactly when every count is at most one, which is equivalent to using every group member exactly once in the original task.

G4_naturalness.justification: The relay framing is coherent and readable, though the introduced “global isolation metric” is somewhat artificial compared with the underlying combinatorial requirement.
